title: A Spectacular Scavenger Hunt: Salt Lake's Settlers
includes: Self-Guided Salt Lake City Adventure Hunt
All taxes, fees and handling charges
Digital Copies of your adventure hunt photos
Photo challenges for each player - choose between Braniac, Photographer, Mapper
Let's Roam App access for maps, photo challenges, riddles and leaderboards
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Weather Check: Check the weather forecast for the day of your hunt and dress appropriately. Comfortable shoes and weather appropriate attire are recommended
Please note that this is a self-guided private tour so you can start at any time and at your own pace
Fully Charged Devices: Make sure your smartphone is fully charged before the tour as you’ll be using it to navigate and interact with the app. Please bring a power bank if you need it.
Booking Confirmation: Confirmation will be received at time of booking along with instructions on downloading the app and starting your adventure
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Let’s Roam takes the lead as the top app-led adventure hunt company! Explore the top landmarks and discover hidden gems, solving challenges and answering trivia along the way. Whether you collaborate with your team or compete against them, you’ll uncover new facts and craft unforgettable experiences. 

Let’s Roam Adventure Hunts are perfect for any occasion—whether it’s a daily adventure, a bachelorette bash, a birthday celebration, corporate team building, and beyond! Each player selects an interactive role with challenges tailored uniquely to them.
